summary: FAR AI (by FAR Labs) opened early-access registration for AI builders on June 22, 2026. Builders who join the waitlist can claim 1 million free inference tokens. Applicants share their use case, current setup and monthly token volume; FAR AI reviews each request and sends an access path.
claim_steps: Open the FAR AI 'Join as AI builder' page
Join the waitlist and share your use case, current setup, and monthly token volume
Wait for FAR AI to review the request and send your access path, then claim the 1M free tokens

social_proof.title: FAR AI | Turn your idle GPU into a revenue generating asset
social_proof.text: Claim 1M free tokens and start building on FAR AI. Join the wait list and get early access to reliable, lower-cost inference. Share your use case, current setup, and monthly token volume. We review your use case and send the right access path.
